description.value:
You slowly unlock the full power of the Demon Realm. You gain access to Mashin-jin Feats.

At 1st Level, you know the Thaumaturgy Cantrip. When you reach 3rd Level, you gain the Hellish Rebuke Spell. When you reach 5th Level, you gain the Fireball Spell. These Spells are cast through the Mysticism Feature but can not be casted at a higher Spell Level.

At 10th Level you may cast these spells at a higher Spell Level as if through the Mysticism Feature.

At 15th Level you may add any 3 Spells that deal damage of 5th level or below to this feature.
